entities.summary: Leopoldo de Gregorio, 1st Marquess of Esquilache, OWE, known in Spanish as Marqués de Esquilache and in Italian as Marchese di Squillace, was a Sicilian-born Spanish statesman who was Minister of Finance of Spain between 1759 and 1766.
